system.description:
1/turn · 1 Action · Costs: 1 Toolbelt scrap.

You deploy a turret in an adjacent space.

[A] Pick one of your known turrets (Rifle plus your Mechanical Mayhem picks); the module places it in an adjacent space and spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — or the Testing In Progress! free deploy — with an Undo chat card.

[A] The 1/turn limit is enforced (shift-click to override); Master Technician lifts it and allows 2 active turrets.

[A] The spawned turret gets its destruction threshold (LVL, 2xLVL with Extra Plating), INT scaling, Overclocked bonuses and your save DC automatically.

[M] Mechanical Prodigy (level 20): drag the turret anywhere within Reach 8 after it is placed.
